Storage for phone, sunglasses and drinks

Proposal
1, implement. Storage compartments (20 rows) and front console (15 rows) complaints match the study gaps in phone storage (4.78 vs 5.47) and cup holders (4.80 vs 5.42).
Horizon
H1. Trim parts in the life-cycle impulse.
Domain
Space & Practicality
Markets
US
Evidence level
B (the best level of the primary and supporting findings)
Status
proposed, version 1
Reference
REQ-G70-US-SP-01 (the key of the decisions, the audit trail and the exports)

Statement

The cabin shall offer a phone place with the screen visible, a sunglasses holder, cup holders that hold different bottle sizes and more covered storage for the driver.

Acceptance criteria

One row per market where expectations differ. Basis: evidence is a measured study value or a count; assumption is the agent's proposal for the product manager to set.

MarketMetricTargetHow measuredBasis
USStudy phone storage (1-7)>= 5.4 (today 4.78, peer 5.47)Next US customer study waveevidence
USStudy cup holders (1-7)>= 5.4 (today 4.80, peer 5.42)Next US customer study waveevidence
